gm.motif: compact (TiO2)6 with 2 terminal Ti=O (1.691 A), 9 two-fold and 1 three-fold O, Ti CN 4(x4),5(x2), nine planar Ti2O2 4-rings; O-O >= 2.58 A, Ti-Ti >= 2.85 A
gm.literature: DFT GMs of small (TiO2)n are compact with 4/5-fold Ti and 1-2 terminal Ti=O (Qu & Kroes JPCB 110, 8998 (2006); Lamiel-Garcia et al. Nanoscale 9, 1049 (2017)); exact match to the (TiO2)6 DFT GM not verified

notes: Final budget 47500 = 3 x BH median hit 15820 (BH SR 1.0, RS SR 0.2 at 47500). Same-structure GM energies within 1 meV -> e_tol 0.02. Guard caveat: Ti-O guard r0 = 0.75*(1.60+0.66) = 1.695 A lies above the NEP89 titanyl bond (1.674 A in TiO2, 1.69 A here), so the guard adds ~0.1-0.3 meV per Ti=O; harmless for ranking but a TM-oxo-specific r0 would be cleaner.

bulk_reference_nep89.verdict: cluster less stable than bulk (no NEP89-hole signature)

validate_gm.flag: dmin 0.75 < 0.77 from the two terminal Ti=O (1.691 A / (1.60+0.66) A). This is NEP89's own titanyl bond (guard-free tight relaxation: 1.690 A, guard shifts it by 0.002 A and 0.4 meV) and is physical: NEP89 gives TiO 1.622 A (exp. 1.620) and molecular TiO2 1.674 A (exp. 1.651); coordinator accepted cl_Ti6O12.
